goal: Build and independently verify autonomous staged cognitive/artifact garbage metabolism, enforce a two-backup maximum, and prove a three-slot Golden Triangle can coordinate cleanup without contaminating durable state.

responsibilities: read canonical durable state before action
issue exactly one smallest authorized task packet
receive only independently verified metabolism summaries
self-clear only low-risk stage garbage after guards pass
emit before/after manifest, hashes, reclaimed-count/size evidence, and BUILT_NOT_VERIFIED handoff
independently verify B manifests and hashes
verify no live references or unique evidence were deleted
forbidden: silently repair B output while verifying

groups.name: WORKING_EXCHANGE
groups.purpose: the only full working copy that another authorized slot/window may modify or transform
groups.mutation: allowed only on authorized candidate/development scope

backup_policy.historical_retention: use git refs/commits, diffs, hashes, minimal Evidence and Lessons instead of additional full backup copies
backup_policy.rotation_rule: never materialize a third full backup; replace/rotate WORKING_EXCHANGE only after verifier confirms recoverability and reference safety

auto_clear_allowed_classes: expired TTL artifacts with no references
superseded intermediate candidates reproducible from retained source/config
duplicate proof outputs already represented by authoritative evidence
must_quarantine_or_escalate: files referenced by current durable state
deletion_guards: Verifier post-check for any nontrivial cleanup
metabolism_policy.self_clear_rule: B may physically remove only low-risk stage garbage when all machine-checkable guards pass; otherwise move to quarantine/mark WASTE_CANDIDATE and hand to C
metabolism_policy.evidence_retention: retain minimal manifest/hash/lesson, not full raw worksite logs

worker_spawn_requirement.objective: A must be able to instantiate or activate B and C without the user manually maintaining visible browser windows
acceptable_implementation: separate bounded ChatGPT automation worker slots
another equivalent isolated cloud worker mechanism with durable-state handoff
worker_spawn_requirement.reason: the required property is replaceable isolated workers with durable handoff, not UI window ownership

main_default_branch.allowed_preparation: prepare and independently review a launcher revision on the candidate branch
main_default_branch.write_gate: a main/default-branch launcher revision requires an explicit reviewed sub-gate before write; no other main content may be modified

acceptance: backup invariant proves no more than two full backup groups at any time
B can autonomously classify and clear a controlled fixture of stage garbage without deleting protected material
C independently detects at least one intentionally unsafe deletion candidate and blocks/fails it
A receives a verified compact metabolism report and does not ingest raw worksite garbage
three isolated authorized slots can hand off durable state without duplicate consumption
worker loss/restart does not lose mission state
real cloud execution evidence proves A→B→C→A for a cleanup cycle
Metabolic Closure returns mission to IDLE/PASS with explicit KEEP/WASTE/QUARANTINE dispositions
stop_conditions: main/default-branch write is required before explicit reviewed sub-gate
unique or unreproducible material could be deleted
production deployment, money/account action, privilege expansion, or irreversible high-risk deletion is required
next_mission_after_success: must not auto-create; autonomy expansion requires a separately authorized next mission
